decisive_items: Electrophysiologic studies: Showed no abnormalities in the cardiac conduction system.
The rhythm strip demonstrated gradual slowing of the sinus rate and atrioventricular conduction followed by complete atrioventricular block.
Asystole derived from gradually extended PR and PP intervals and was transiently suspended by a spontaneous junctional escape beat.
response.rationale: Normal electrophysiologic evaluation and a gradual, transient sinus/AV conduction suppression with junctional escape favor a cardioinhibitory vasovagal mechanism rather than intrinsic sick sinus syndrome.

rejected.why: Sick sinus syndrome is less likely because the electrophysiologic studies showed no intrinsic conduction-system abnormality, and the gradual PP/PR prolongation with transient complete AV block is characteristic of a reflex vagal cause.
